TaskDescription: Delayed memory-guided action task: jittered fixation (1.9-2.1 s, white cross), encoding (2 s; central red cross and two objects, either two identical circles ('same', condition 2) or a square and a triangle ('different', condition 3), one always closer to the cross with a distance ratio of 1.5), jittered delay (3.9-4.1 s), action/recall (2 s, green cross; joystick reach to the remembered position of the object nearer to the cross). In 'different' trials a 2-s two-alternative question on the identity of the nearer object follows. 160 delayed trials in blocks of 10 of one condition, preceded by training blocks; 160 immediate trials were also run but are not in the release (Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Methods).
Instructions: Participants were told to remember which object was closer to the central cross: its position (same condition) or its position and identity (different condition), and to reach for it with the joystick after the delay. The experiment began with a brief presentation explaining the task, then training blocks of five trials per condition with feedback after each trial; simple on-screen instructions about the upcoming condition were shown at the start of each block (Moraresku et al. 2025 Neurosci Bull 41:1347-1363, doi:10.1007/s12264-025-01371-x, Methods).
InstitutionName: Motol University Hospital, Motol Epilepsy Center
